Characteristics
Pours quickly from a cup but slower than
regular, unmodiﬁed ﬂuids. May leave
a coating ﬁlm of residue in the cup after
being poured. Drink this ﬂuid thickness
from a cup. Effort required to take this
thickness via a standard bore straw
Cohesive and pours slowly. Possible to
drink directly from a cup although ﬂuid
ﬂows very slowly. Difﬁcult to drink using
a straw, even if using a wide-bore straw
Cohesive and holds its shape on a spoon. It
is not possible to pour this type of ﬂuid
from a cup into the mouth. Spoon is the
optimal method for taking this type of
ﬂuid. This ﬂuid is too thick if the spoon is
able to stand upright in it
